seatedToss.guidance: Nofo ʻi ha tēpile pea fai ʻa e tuʻunga ʻe taha-taha ke liʻaki ha ʻato malu ki he feinga lalahi. Tauhi ʻa e fakatotolo ʻi he pepa, fakataha.
seatedToss.stepsHeading: Ko e founga ʻoku fai ai
steps: Pulusi ʻa e feinga mo e pepa fakatotolo, pea tuʻu ia mafolahola ʻi he tēpile ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo kimoutolu.
Nofo fakafiefia, taha ʻi he tafaʻaki kotoa. Fai ʻa e tō ʻofa taha-taha, pe tuʻu atu ʻo taʻe fai ha meʻa kapau ʻoku ʻikai ke ke loto.
Kapau ʻoku tō ai ʻa e ʻato ʻi ha kafo, ʻe tohi ʻe he taha naʻe tō ʻa e kahoa taha ʻi honau kolomu, ʻi he laine ʻo e kafo ko iá.
Vakai ki he ngaahi tohi fakataha ʻi he ngataʻanga, kapau ʻoku ke fie. ʻOku ʻikai ke fiemaʻu ʻe ha taha ke fakakakato ha meʻa.
Ngataʻi ʻi he taimi ʻoku loto ai ha taha.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Ko e ʻato pe ko e sokisi naʻe kui ʻa e kapa pe kuo tofi, nofo ʻi he nofoʻanga, ʻoua ʻe tō ki he mata, pea tauhi ha tokotaha lalahi ʻi ofi. Ko e ngaahi meʻa iki ʻoku lava ke mamau ai ha taha.
flags: ʻIkai ki he ʻoku lalo ʻi he 3: ngaahi meʻa iki
safety: Fili ha ʻato kuo tofi ʻa e kapa, pe fakahinga ha sokisi maʻa. Siviʻi muamua ki ha ngaahi ʻava pe ngaahi fatu ʻoku mōmoa, koeʻuhi ke ʻikai ke lava ke hao ha meʻa mei loto.
Ko e ngaahi fihi, laisi mo e ngaahi meʻa iki kehe ʻoku lava ke mamau ai ha taha. Tauhi ia mamaʻo mei he ngaahi tamaiki iiki mo ha taha ʻoku ʻai ha meʻa ki hono ngutu.
Tuʻu ʻi ha ʻofi ʻo ka hanga ʻo toʻo ha nima, pea vakai lelei ʻi ha meʻa ʻe lava ke ʻai ki he ngutu.
Nofo ʻi he nofoʻanga. Tō ʻofa pea ʻi lalo ki he feinga ʻi he tēpile, ʻoua ʻe tō ki ha mata.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Ko e pepa kuo pulusi: ko ha feinga ʻe tolu ʻoku ui ko e Ofi, Lotolotonga mo Mamaʻo, mei tuʻa ki loto, mo ha fakatotolo ʻoku ʻi ai ha kolomu ki ha taha kotoa mo ha laine ʻo e kahoa maka ki he kafo kotoa.

steps: Paʻi ʻa e ngaahi peesi kotoa. Ko e peesi muʻa ko e ngaahi founga ni mo e mape ʻo e pā.
Ko e tokotaha kotoa ʻoku ʻave ʻe taha pe lahi ange ʻo e ngaahi peesi, pea tā lanu ia.
ʻOku ʻikai ngaue ke fetaulaki ʻa e lanu mo e founga. Ko e peesi kotoa ko e konga ʻo e pikitia taha pē.
Fakatuʻu ʻa e ngaahi peesi ʻi honau ngaahi leipolo, pea toki fakafeʻauhi ʻaki ʻa e tepi ʻi he tuʻa tafaʻaki.
Fakahīkihiki ʻa e pā ʻi he feituʻu ʻe mamata ai ʻe he kotoa.
